caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table-like object with a rectangular box on top, standing on a single central pedestal that extends to a tripod base with decorative scrollwork at each foot. The box has a hinged lid which is open at a right angle, revealing a glass or mirrored interior surface on the inside of the lid. The exterior and pedestal of the box have a reddish-brown wood appearance, while the top surface inside the box contains a geometric pattern of green and black squares with a prominent central rectangular red section. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small signature at the bottom right corner that reads "Charles Goodwin '38."
title: Sewing Table
